cuts.head: over_shoulder
cuts.placeText: a quiet residential street — a delivery bicycle with a front basket, mailboxes, a stack of boxes at a doorstep and a stone wall
cuts.scene: she is a veteran courier glancing back over her shoulder with a parcel raised beside her face
cuts.outfit: a parcel courier look fitted to her body — a fitted short-sleeved courier jacket zipped low over a short skort with sneakers, bare legs, a pair of wing-shaped patches on her sleeves
